## Design grill for the trigger/plugin model

- Ran the design grill with the maintainer. All grill questions were accepted.
- Locked the model: `## Triggers` as the one declaration format; one normalized namespace across policies and procedures with duplicates and whole-word overlap invalid; one shared `STEP-PROTOCOL-INDEX` defined once in `AGENTS.md`; an ephemeral index in the AI's context with no file, cache, or runtime script; the existing validators remain dev-time tests.
- Dispatch: deterministic whole-word matching plus the Directive versus Inquiry gate; ambiguity asks; multiple distinct triggers run in order; no module runs twice.
- Modules: procedure bodies move to `(Global AI Workflow Directory)/ai/procedures/` in Stage 2; no project procedure directory; policies never hold procedures; procedures require at least one trigger, policies may omit.
- Session: triggered policies are session-scoped with a compaction caveat; nothing is persisted; procedures run once; no unload command.
- Delivery: Stage 1 policy plugin, minor release; Stage 2 procedure modules plus thinning, major release; skills separate. INV-001..INV-016 and the change rule are the mutation guard.
- Recorded the skills runtime-collision requirement in the skills ticket Notes.
- State changes are uncommitted, per the checkpoint rule; the next work item carries them.
